packages.title: Confirm baseline, cohort and ownership
packages.currentState: Source audit is broad; authenticated workflow coverage and user demand baselines are missing.
packages.objective: Establish a reproducible starting point and named decision owners.
tasks: Record current HEAD, local changes and running revision without resetting work. Revalidate each finding before implementation.
Select synthetic tenant fixtures and authorized role cohort; measure the eight task baselines. Assign a named person to each owner role.
Reconcile work with parent roadmap R00/R01; record already completed work and acceptance evidence rather than rebuilding it.
packages.dataImpact: No migration. Use isolated representative test data; record fixture provenance.
packages.controls: Do not use production financial mutations to establish a baseline. Record unavailable environments explicitly.
packages.verification: Reproduce source entry points and baseline tasks; inventory denied, limited and full roles and EN/FR fixtures.
packages.releaseGate: G0: scope, baseline evidence and accountable owners recorded.
packages.blockers: Authenticated test session, representative users and runtime-to-revision mapping remain unavailable until arranged.
packages.definitionOfDone: All eight cases have a baseline or explicit missing-evidence entry; owners and first cohort are assigned.

packages.title: Freeze shared read, command and UI-state contracts
packages.currentState: Domain controls and shared route states exist, but new feature contracts are not yet defined.
packages.objective: Specify the smallest safe contracts before building new surfaces.
tasks: Define minimal DTOs, pagination, query budgets, source freshness and safe local return URLs for the eight cases.
Resolve organization, entity, location, permissions and entitlements before querying records, counts or snippets.
Write state tables for loading, empty, partial, denied, stale, failed and uncertain outcomes; reuse primitives and EN/FR conventions.
packages.dataImpact: No shared business-status table. Each domain retains its own authoritative states.
packages.controls: Resolve the customer read versus analytics destination mismatch without granting additional authority. Do not infer write rights from visibility.
packages.verification: Contract examples include foreign tenant, limited location, revoked role, disabled module and stale session. Review output fields for privacy.
packages.releaseGate: G1: domain owners approve DTOs, transition tables, permission matrix and test contracts.
packages.blockers: D02 destination choice, D03 proof eligibility and D08 recovery authority must be decided before dependent command work.
packages.definitionOfDone: No unresolved critical authority or source-of-truth ambiguity remains for each slice entering implementation.

packages.title: Build item read projection
packages.currentState: Item edit and related activity exist; no minimal general reader projection is established by the audit.
packages.objective: Return item identity and authoritative stock limited to the reader’s permitted locations.
tasks: Add a scoped read service and action using current inventory truth.
Project identity, unit, archive state, permitted quantities and freshness; provide authorized movement/supplier links.
Distinguish not found, no visible location, zero, unknown and unavailable.
packages.dataImpact: Reuse existing tables; add an index only after a measured query-plan need.
packages.controls: Do not return edit DTOs wholesale. Costs, margins and supplier terms require explicit field authority.
packages.verification: Test read-without-update, foreign tenant, hidden locations, archived/deleted records, sensitive fields and unavailable stock.
packages.releaseGate: G2: projection and privacy tests pass on representative fixtures.
packages.blockers: Inventory quantity semantics and location-scoping contracts require domain-owner confirmation.
packages.definitionOfDone: Read-only users receive correct authorized facts with no business mutation and no hidden-location totals.

packages.title: Deliver item overview and entry points
packages.currentState: Item names are plain text and row actions emphasize edit/delete; related routes are fragmented.
packages.objective: Make an item inspectable from a stable read destination.
tasks: Add the localized overview route and register it in the current inventory access catalog.
Link item names and View item actions; render identity, stock, source links and conditional edit controls.
Use shared state components and explain zero, unknown, restricted and failed reads accurately.
packages.dataImpact: No migration or derived stock storage.
packages.controls: Route and source links recheck permissions; hiding a button is not authorization.
packages.verification: Authenticated read-only and denied-role browser tasks; EN/FR, keyboard/focus and 390px plus desktop layouts.
packages.releaseGate: G3/G4: task completion and role-negative evidence accepted; expose first to the selected cohort.
packages.blockers: Authenticated browser fixtures remain required; screenshots alone do not prove authorization.
packages.definitionOfDone: Users answer the baseline item questions without entering edit; overview can be disabled without changing inventory.

packages.title: Implement bounded record-search adapters
packages.currentState: Domain list queries exist; current PO listing is unsuitable as an unbounded header-search source.
packages.objective: Search items, customers and POs with scoped, bounded server queries.
tasks: Create domain adapters and a small aggregator with exact-reference and text matching.
Apply scope before counts and limits; cap results per domain, enforce time budgets and explicit partial results.
Resolve accessible record destinations, deterministic ordering and minimal distinguishable snippets. Inspect query plans at representative volume.
packages.dataImpact: No search index service initially. Add database indexes only from plan evidence and migration review.
packages.controls: Exclude payroll, payment and other sensitive record types from the first release. Do not return inaccessible customer analytics destinations.
packages.verification: Test exact SKU/code/reference, ambiguous names, tenant/location negatives, inaccessible destinations, timeouts and bounded query plans.
packages.releaseGate: G2: scoped retrieval and measured performance meet D09 budgets.
packages.blockers: D02 basic customer profile versus existing destination; representative dataset size is not yet established.
packages.definitionOfDone: Each enabled domain has bounded queries, correct links and zero unauthorized snippets/counts in negative fixtures.

packages.title: Integrate business search into the shell
packages.currentState: Navbar currently searches authorized navigation destinations only.
packages.objective: Let users find pages and records from one understandable keyboard-accessible interaction.
tasks: Preserve page search and add separate Records groups with recognizable type/reference/context.
Debounce requests, cancel obsolete work, suppress stale responses and clear results when session or organization changes.
Support loading, no results, partial domains, retry and preserved query text.
packages.dataImpact: No persistent sensitive search history in the first release.
packages.controls: Use server permission decisions and allowlisted local destinations; never infer grants from search results.
packages.verification: Browser exact/ambiguous tasks, rapid query changes, tenant switch, transient failure, keyboard selection and EN/FR.
packages.releaseGate: G3/G4: correct-record tasks pass; release item/customer/PO domains independently if one is blocked.
packages.blockers: Requires UX03 destination and UX04 query contract; destination mismatch cannot be hidden by UI.
packages.definitionOfDone: Users reach the intended authorized records with complete partial/error behavior and no stale-result replacement.

packages.title: Resolve payroll proof from controlled records
packages.currentState: Settlement already enforces proof and balance controls, but forms require technical hashes.
packages.objective: Expose eligible evidence and resolve submitted record IDs to current proof inside the controlled settlement operation.
tasks: Project eligible register versions and existing provider/match/statement evidence with readable context.
Accept stable record IDs and resolve authoritative hashes and eligibility in the transactional command.
Preserve balance revision, amount/currency checks, current authority, separation of duties, idempotency and close invalidation; review compatibility of existing callers.
packages.dataImpact: Reuse existing records/events; no evidence upload or new proof-truth table in this slice.
packages.controls: Reject stale, revoked, ambiguous, mismatched and foreign-tenant sources. Selection alone cannot settle a batch.
packages.verification: Extend focused settlement tests for eligible IDs, races, replay/unknown outcomes and every rejection condition; use transactional integration fixtures.
packages.releaseGate: G2: payroll and controls owners approve evidence semantics and regression evidence.
packages.blockers: D03 eligibility/version policy and test fixtures; no statutory formula changes are included.
packages.definitionOfDone: No client-supplied hash determines business truth, and existing controlled settlement invariants remain demonstrated.

packages.title: Replace manual payroll hashes with guided selection
packages.currentState: Source-register and evidence hash text fields are blank despite linked source context.
packages.objective: Complete settlement-proof submission without technical identifier copying.
tasks: Add eligible register/evidence selectors with reference, version, date, amount, currency and review status.
Show remaining obligation and confirmation summary; explain unavailable evidence and link to its source workflow.
Keep hashes in optional technical details; retain appropriate inputs through validation, stale-session and uncertain-result recovery.
packages.dataImpact: No new evidence storage.
packages.controls: Never display selected evidence as confirmed payment; server checks remain authoritative.
packages.verification: First-submit task without a hash; stale/revoked/no-evidence and partial/final amount flows; fresh-auth return, EN/FR and keyboard errors.
packages.releaseGate: G3/G4: payroll task and controls regression evidence accepted before pilot.
packages.blockers: Authorized payroll fixtures and reviewer access are required.
packages.definitionOfDone: Eligible proof can be selected and submitted, ineligible choices explain recovery, and unknown outcomes cannot duplicate settlement.

packages.title: Project communication delivery exceptions
packages.currentState: Statement and invitation histories have source-owned recovery; no cross-record discovery projection was found.
packages.objective: Provide a durable, paginated exception read model over existing delivery sources.
tasks: Start with statement and invitation adapters, source links and masked recipients.
Keep queued, accepted, confirmed delivered, failed, deferred and unknown meanings explicit by transport capability.
Filter by authorized source/channel/state/date; add receipt support only after its recovery contract is verified.
packages.dataImpact: Reuse outbox/history storage. No new delivery engine or generic notification status model.
packages.controls: Apply source permissions before paging/counting; redact tokens and destinations; preserve consent and disabled-transport semantics.
packages.verification: Test durable reload, scope, redaction, partial adapter failure, unknown outcome and disabled-provider labels.
packages.releaseGate: G2: source owners approve status mapping and privacy contract.
packages.blockers: D04 channel certainty mapping and operator ownership; delivered status requires source evidence.
packages.definitionOfDone: Exceptions remain discoverable across reloads with accurate source status and authorized recovery links.

packages.title: Deliver the communications worklist
packages.currentState: Users must know which source record to open to discover delivery failure.
packages.objective: Give operators a clear queue and next action for delivery issues.
tasks: Add Delivery issues at an authorized destination with filters, age, masked recipient, source reference and last safe reason.
Link to existing recovery workflows and refresh from source truth after a retry.
Document ownership, unknown-result handling and escalation; release the read-only queue first.
packages.dataImpact: No new send log, bulk-send mechanism or delivery assertion.
packages.controls: Do not send messages on page load or acknowledgment. Existing retries retain authority and duplicate protection.
packages.verification: Test failed/deferred/unknown discovery, safe source retry handoff, reload, provider-disabled and EN/FR accessible layouts.
packages.releaseGate: G3/G4: support can complete the exception task; no live external sends required for test evidence.
packages.blockers: Communications owner must accept queue responsibility and escalation policy.
packages.definitionOfDone: Each displayed issue has an accurate state and useful authorized next step; acknowledgment never implies delivery.

packages.title: Build redacted cross-record audit reads
packages.currentState: AuditLog and domain histories exist; an eight-event accounting projection is not a general explorer.
packages.objective: Support filtered investigations without exposing raw audit payloads.
tasks: Start with access and item event families; allowlist readable fields per event type.
Apply organization/audit/entity/location authority before cursor pagination and counts.
Specify stable snapshot/order semantics, event coverage limitations and authorized source links.
packages.dataImpact: Reuse existing audit indexes subject to query-plan validation; do not rewrite historical events or add an audit table solely for this view.
packages.controls: Never emit raw changes JSON, IP or user-agent by default. Do not equate visibility with completeness or tamper resistance.
packages.verification: Test field redaction, revoked authority, foreign tenant, pagination under concurrent events and bounded query plans.
packages.releaseGate: G2: event allowlist and coverage statements accepted by privacy and domain owners.
packages.blockers: D05 visible fields/retention and actual event-family coverage must be reviewed.
packages.definitionOfDone: Allowed events can be filtered safely with stable pagination and explicit coverage boundaries.

packages.title: Deliver audit investigation workflows
packages.currentState: Users cannot investigate changes through a general cross-record view.
packages.objective: Reconstruct defined access/item incidents without developer log access.
tasks: Add date/actor/action/entity filters, cursor navigation and safe event details.
Distinguish source unavailable, detail redacted and event coverage missing.
Provide authorized source links and task guidance; defer financial families and exports until separately reviewed.
packages.dataImpact: No export storage or new historical truth.
packages.controls: Read-only explorer does not add audit-write or source-edit authority; filters cannot bypass entity permissions.
packages.verification: Browser reconstructs baseline incidents; test restricted details, lost authority, fixed-snapshot paging, EN/FR and keyboard.
packages.releaseGate: G3/G4: investigation task accepted with explicit source coverage limits.
packages.blockers: Representative synthetic incident timeline and D05 field decisions are needed.
packages.definitionOfDone: Operators reconstruct the agreed scenarios from safe evidence and see when evidence is incomplete.

packages.title: Implement durable access-request lifecycle
packages.currentState: Denial pages advise contacting an administrator; actual grant services already exist.
packages.objective: Track requests and decisions while preserving current grant authority.
tasks: Add tenant/requester/normalized-target/reason/reviewer/revision/timestamps and durable transitions; deduplicate pending requests and support withdrawal/expiry.
Separate pending/approved/declined/withdrawn/expired decisions from grant application pending/applied/failed states.
Use current grant services with current reviewer ceilings, no self-approval, revision fencing and audit events; verify effective access before claiming completion.
packages.dataImpact: Additive migration with tenant indexes and pending uniqueness strategy; avoid backfill unless a real historical source exists. Set retention before rollout.
packages.controls: No automatic subscriptions, purchases, module activation or entitlement bypass. Requesters cannot set tenant/reviewer/grants arbitrarily.
packages.verification: Database concurrency, duplicate creation, competing decisions, revoked reviewers, self-approval, partial grant failure and safe retry; migration rehearsal.
packages.releaseGate: G2: security approves transitions and grant boundary; schema and concurrency checks pass.
packages.blockers: D06 reviewer ownership, expiry, notification policy and service recovery behavior.
packages.definitionOfDone: Every decision and application attempt is attributable; approved is never falsely presented as effective access.

packages.title: Connect denials to requester and reviewer queues
packages.currentState: NotAuthorized offers navigation but no tracked handoff.
packages.objective: Let staff request review, track the decision and safely return after access is verified.
tasks: Offer request review for eligible authenticated permission denials with task and reason.
Provide requester timeline and authorized reviewer queue with explicit decision and application outcomes.
Keep expired authentication, unavailable modules and permission denials distinct; use allowlisted local callback paths.
packages.dataImpact: Use UX12 storage; no parallel request cache or email-only workflow.
packages.controls: Notifications and denial labels reveal no protected records; no requester self-approval or client-computed access success.
packages.verification: Role/tenant negatives, reviewer revocation, withdrawal/expiry, failed grant, safe return and EN/FR keyboard tasks.
packages.releaseGate: G3/G4: staff and reviewers complete the handoff; rollback disables new submissions while preserving history.
packages.blockers: A real reviewer must own the queue; elapsed SLA is not authorization to grant access.
packages.definitionOfDone: Requests have visible ownership and accurate status, and return navigation succeeds only after current authority is checked.

packages.title: Persist new-PO drafts and fence order creation
packages.currentState: Create service allocates and creates in a transaction; no replay fence was found in that inspected create path. Edit drafts already exist separately.
packages.objective: Preserve incomplete authoring and resolve uncertain create results without duplicate orders.
tasks: Add scoped durable authoring drafts with revision, incomplete-field support and explicit save/discard; keep them separate from business PO lifecycle.
Persist a stable create request key, canonical payload hash and atomic result linkage; inspect existing event/idempotency infrastructure before choosing additive storage.
On retry return the same result for same payload, reject key reuse with changed payload and expose scoped request-status lookup. Recheck current validation and authority when creating.
packages.dataImpact: Likely additive draft model plus unique organization/request fence or compatible existing infrastructure. Review retention, index and migration plans; no business-data backfill by default.
packages.controls: Saving an authoring draft allocates no PO number, stock, payable or outbound message. Server document numbering and transactional validation remain authoritative.
packages.verification: Concurrent creates, lost response after commit, replay after tab closure, changed payload, revoked permission, multi-tab revision conflict and migration rehearsal.
packages.releaseGate: G2: database tests prove one order per accepted request and correct conflict recovery.
packages.blockers: D07 draft retention and durability policy; compatibility with existing business-event infrastructure requires inspection.
packages.definitionOfDone: An uncertain submission can be resolved without issuing a new key, and incomplete drafts survive the agreed interruption boundaries.

packages.title: Deliver new-PO save, resume and recovery UX
packages.currentState: ModernCreatePurchaseOrderForm keeps authoring in state; edit form has scoped session draft and uncertain-result protection.
packages.objective: Restore new-order work and make saved, unsaved and uncertain states understandable.
tasks: Integrate durable save/resume/discard with honest saved-state feedback and revision conflicts.
Retain the stable request identity across submission; resolve status before offering same-key retry after uncertainty.
Clear actor/organization-local data on session changes and preserve the existing edit recovery behavior; reconcile changed suppliers/items before submission.
packages.dataImpact: Use UX14 draft/request persistence; do not store sensitive drafts under unscoped browser keys.
packages.controls: Never label an uncertain create as definitely failed or encourage a new submission key before resolution.
packages.verification: Close/reopen, navigation interruption, network/storage failure, sign-out/in, tenant switch, multi-tab and commit-with-lost-response scenarios; existing edit tests remain passing.
packages.releaseGate: G3/G4: restore and uncertain-result tasks pass before enabling writes for the cohort.
packages.blockers: UX14 durable contract and explicit policy for unsaved local edits on logout.
packages.definitionOfDone: Users recover the last confirmed saved draft, understand any unsaved delta and cannot duplicate a committed PO by retrying the same request.

packages.title: Expose safe alert processing diagnostics
packages.currentState: Inbox worker tracks attempts, retry time and safe error codes; dashboard maps business payload status and omits processing fields.
packages.objective: Explain whether a reconciliation alert is queued, delayed, leased, retried or dead-lettered.
tasks: Add a dedicated operator projection of processing state, attempts, last safe error, age, next attempt and eligibility.
Keep scan state, business notification meaning and worker lifecycle separate in names and presentation.
Reuse existing inbox records and query scope; check current indexes before adding any.
packages.dataImpact: No new queue. Read existing fields; no attempt resets or destructive status normalization.
packages.controls: Do not reuse the worker DTO in the browser: it includes leaseToken. Omit lease secrets, payload secrets and sensitive proof details.
packages.verification: Test all worker states, redaction, foreign tenants, live leases, missing metadata and bounded projections.
packages.releaseGate: G2: SRE/domain owner approve status meanings and safe disclosure.
packages.blockers: D08 operator authority and recoverability classification; processing state must not be mistaken for settlement.
packages.definitionOfDone: Operators can distinguish stalled versus scheduled work with safe data and accurate next-action eligibility.

packages.title: Add guarded alert recovery and escalation
packages.currentState: DurableNotificationInbox shows recorded alerts; no inspected operator diagnostic/recovery handoff exists.
packages.objective: Recover eligible processing failures while protecting leases, poison-message handling and auditability.
tasks: Render diagnostic details and source links in the existing inbox; release read-only diagnostics first.
Implement an explicit scoped recovery command using current authority, revision/request-key fencing and an audit event. Reuse safe worker transition primitives.
Reject active-lease theft; escalate poison/redaction failures with a runbook rather than blindly retrying. Refresh authoritative outcome after commands.
packages.dataImpact: Reuse queue and event data; add a recovery command record only if current idempotency/audit infrastructure cannot meet the contract.
packages.controls: Recovery affects alert processing only, never reconciliation settlement, accounting balances or proof truth. Do not expose worker lease tokens.
packages.verification: Concurrent operator/worker race, live lease, revoked authority, replay, poison payload, dead-letter recovery and safe errors; browser status interpretation task.
packages.releaseGate: G3/G4: diagnostics can ship first; recovery commands require the stricter concurrency and runbook gate.
packages.blockers: D08 retry authority, escalation owner and worker-transition compatibility.
packages.definitionOfDone: Eligible work recovers once, ineligible work explains escalation, and no financial or lease invariant is bypassed.

packages.title: Complete integration and release evidence
packages.currentState: Current tests cover foundations, not the eight proposed end-to-end workflows.
packages.objective: Prove each delivered slice and its interactions on a reproducible release candidate.
tasks: Run focused unit/contract and real-database integration tests for changed boundaries; rehearse additive migrations on disposable data.
Execute authorized, denied and limited-role browser tasks in EN/FR at 390px and desktop; include keyboard, focus and screen-reader checks.
Record query-budget measurements, rollback rehearsal, source/runtime revision and unresolved defects; map every UC acceptance check to evidence.
packages.dataImpact: No production migration through a generic build command. Use reviewed migration workflow and disposable rehearsal fixtures.
packages.controls: Zero accepted unauthorized disclosure, duplicate create/grant, stale proof acceptance or lease theft in negative fixtures.
packages.verification: G2/G3 evidence plus feature-specific acceptance matrix; command-bearing features need race/uncertain-result checks beyond screenshots.
packages.releaseGate: G4 is evaluated per feature so completed slices can pilot; aggregate UX18 closes only after all eight pass.
packages.blockers: Authenticated test environment, database fixtures and reviewer availability remain release blockers until supplied.
packages.definitionOfDone: Each enabled feature has complete evidence and no unresolved critical/high defect; deferred features remain disabled and explicitly tracked.

packages.title: Pilot, measure and hand over operations
packages.currentState: Value expectations have not been measured and feature ownership is not yet assigned by name.
packages.objective: Confirm task value and operational supportability before broader rollout.
tasks: Start the agreed cohort per G4-approved feature; train users on tasks, uncertainty and escalation.
Compare task outcomes with UX00 baseline, review privacy-safe telemetry and gather failure reports.
Exercise feature rollback, preserve drafts/requests/audit history, assign support and monitoring ownership, then decide expansion.
packages.dataImpact: Roll back exposure and command entry points; do not drop additive tables or delete historical requests/drafts during feature rollback.
packages.controls: No automatic command activation or broad rollout when baseline/reviewer evidence is missing.
packages.verification: G5 cohort task evidence, metric comparison, incident drill, operator runbook and rollback record.
packages.releaseGate: G5: named product/domain/SRE owners accept outcomes and support; expand incrementally with stop conditions.
packages.blockers: Pilot duration and cohort capacity are decisions, not promised dates. Parent rollout work R31–R33 must be coordinated.
packages.definitionOfDone: All eight features are accepted or explicitly held with an owner and remediation plan; the roadmap is complete only when every accepted proposal has passed its release gate.
